description: Defines a Data Transfer Object (DTO) class 'PayGradeSearchFilterParams' for filtering search parameters related to pay grades in the OrangeHRM system. It extends a base FilterParams class and sets default sorting behavior.

classes.name: PayGradeSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A DTO class for specifying search filters for pay grade entities, including predefined allowed sort fields and setting default sorting.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of the class, setting the default sort field to 'pg.name'.
